_readme: Copy this file to _local/ads-api.config.json and fill it in. That path is
gitignored; only this template is tracked. Never paste a credential into a
chat, a commit, or anywhere outside _local/.
The live smoke test reads it:  cd packages/ads-api && pnpm smoke
It is read-only against Amazon, but creating a report consumes quota, so it

lwa.refreshToken: <refresh token from the OAuth consent flow>

region: <NA | EU | FE — the host the profile lives on>
date: <YYYY-MM-DD, one day, ideally yesterday in the profile's timezone>
